'''2012 Bespin Regionals Morgan Dwyer LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Morgan Dwyer]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
